0022600152.text: The San Antonio Spurs (3-2) host the Minnesota Timberwolves (3-2) in the Spurs' sixth game of the 2026-27 season. San Antonio is on a three-game winning streak, is 2-0 on the road and 1-2 at home, and sits 6th in the West and 3rd in the Southwest, 2 games back, while Minnesota is 8th in the West, 3rd in the Northwest and 1 game back, and has lost its last two. Out for the Spurs are Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf, strain), and out for the Timberwolves are Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in the 2025-26 season the Spurs lost the regular-season series 1-2 before winning the 2025-26 playoffs series 4-2, including a 139-109 victory in Minneapolis on May 15, 2026.
